draftPicker.heading: Resume an application
draftPicker.body: You have more than one application in progress — pick one to continue, or start a new one.

title: New Applicant Registration
subtitle: Complete your BIS registration step by step with guided AI intelligence.

product.suggestionDisclaimer: This is a suggestion based on your product category, not a determination — verify with BIS or the Standards Browser before relying on it.
product.noSuggestion: No suggested standard for this category yet.

documents.noRequirementsYet: Document requirements will appear once a suggested standard is available.
documents.vaultEmpty: No documents saved in your Vault yet — upload a new file instead, or save one from Document Cortex first.

checklistDisclaimer.heading: Illustrative checklist — not authoritative BIS guidance
checklistDisclaimer.body: Which documents are Required, Conditional, or Supporting is generated by the prototype from a small illustrative dataset, not a live BIS requirement list — verify the actual documents required for your application with BIS or an authorized certification body.

documents.conditionalApplies: Based on your applicant type, this document applies to you.
documents.conditionalNotApplicable: Based on your applicant type, this document may not apply to you — verify with BIS before skipping it.

testing.noTests: No specific tests listed for this standard yet.
testing.labMatchingUnavailable: Laboratory matching isn't available in this prototype yet — this step lists the required tests only. Check the BIS-recognized labs list directly for now.

review.confirmationLabel: I confirm the information above is accurate to the best of my knowledge.
review.reappliedFrom: This application was started from a reapplication of {{id}} — review each section before resubmitting.

rejected.heading: Application rejected
rejected.reasonFallback: This application did not meet the requirements for the selected standard.

applicantStep.title: Applicant Details
applicantStep.subtitle: Provide primary contact and applicant identity information.

businessStep.title: Business / Organization Details
businessStep.subtitle: Specify legal entity registration, factory location, and tax identifiers.
businessStep.addressPlaceholder: Plot No, Industrial Area, Street Name

productStep.title: Product & Applicable Standard
productStep.subtitle: Describe your product to match mandatory Indian Standards and QCO orders.
productStep.productNamePlaceholder: e.g. Submersible Water Pump / Electric Iron
productStep.descriptionPlaceholder: Mention power ratings, capacity, material composition, or application...
productStep.suggestedWhy: Matches your selected product category and safety requirements.

documentsStep.title: Required Application Documents
documentsStep.subtitle: Upload or attach compliance documents verified against BIS checklist.

testingStep.title: Testing & Laboratory Information
testingStep.subtitle: Identify required test parameters and recommended accredited BIS laboratories.

reviewStep.title: Review & Final Confirmation
reviewStep.subtitle: Verify all details before submitting your formal application to BIS.
reviewStep.confirmDeclaration: I hereby declare that all information provided is accurate and complies with BIS regulations.

submittedStep.title: Application Submitted Successfully
submittedStep.subtitle: Your application has been registered in the SAATHI e-BIS tracking pipeline.

unsavedModal.title: Leave registration wizard?
unsavedModal.description: You have unsaved changes in your application. Your progress will be lost if you leave without saving.

errors.saveFailed: Couldn't save your draft. Your changes are still here — try again.
errors.uploadFailed: Couldn't upload that document. Try again.
errors.submissionFailed: We couldn't submit your application. Please try again.
errors.backendUnavailableBody: Something went wrong reaching the registration service. Try again.

leaveDialog.title: Leave without saving?
leaveDialog.body: Your last changes haven't been saved yet. If you leave now, they'll be lost.
